name: binsider
description: Terminal user interface for analyzing ELF and binary files with static/dynamic analysis capabilities and hexdump visualization

binsider.description: Analyze ELF binaries and executables with comprehensive TUI interface featuring static analysis, dynamic analysis, strings extraction, and hexdump
binsider.usage:
binsider binary.exe # Analyze executable
binsider --tab strings binary.exe # Start with strings tab
binsider --min-len 10 binary.exe # Minimum string length 10
binsider --accent-color blue binary.exe # Custom accent color
